name: Compute average measures per tract
summary: Averages along-tract measures across nodes to give one value per tract and measure, from a tractmeasures CSV, with pandas.
description: Groups the input tractmeasures.csv by structureID, averages every numeric column over nodes, drops nodeID, and writes output/tractmeasures.csv. Use it to turn tract profiles into per-tract summaries for statistics.

inputs.description: Tractmeasures CSV with structureID and nodeID columns (macro- and microstructural profiles along tracts).

outputs.description: tractmeasures.csv with one row per tract: the mean of each measure across nodes.
